title: Construction of Somapura Mahavihara
subtitle: Paharpur as a major Buddhist monastic center.
summary: Somapura Mahavihara at Paharpur emerged in the 8th century as one of the largest monasteries south of the Himalayas and an important intellectual center in pre-Islamic Bengal.
heroTagline: Somapura links Bengal's political history to architecture, religion, and transregional learning.
whyItMatters: This event matters because it provides durable architectural evidence of Bengal's institutional role in Buddhist scholarship and cultural exchange.
